list.title: Videos
list.emptyHint: Press “New video” and describe what should happen in it.

workspace.spentHint: All money spent on this video, failed attempts included
workspace.removeAsk: Delete the video “{title}”? Its files stay in the media library.

form.modelUnavailable: This model is turned off or not available. Pick another one.
form.soundAlways: This model always makes the video with sound.

cameraMove.title: Camera move
cameraMove.pickHint: The chosen move is added after your text as one sentence. The whole text for the model is shown next to the button.
cameraMove.empty: The camera move list is empty

brief.nichePlaceholder: For example: coffee shop, yoga classes
brief.platformPlaceholder: For example: Reels, Shorts, a website
brief.label: What happens in the video
brief.placeholder: Who or what is in the shot, what happens, where, the light and the mood
brief.verbatim: This text goes to the video model word for word.
brief.research: Search Google for this topic first
brief.researchOn: Before writing, the model looks up what works in such videos now. It costs a little more.
brief.researchOff: The text is written without a search.
brief.researchCached: The search from {date} is used again, free of charge.
brief.researchFailed: The search did not work, so the text was written without it.
brief.nicheNeeded: Fill in what the video is about: the search needs it.
brief.withPhoto: The model also sees the first frame picture.
brief.replaceAsk: The box already has a text. Write a new one instead? The old one can be brought back.
brief.durationChanged: The text was written for {was} s, but the video is now {now} s long.

first.title: First frame
first.hint: The video starts from this picture.
first.unsupported: This model cannot start from a picture.

last.title: Last frame
last.hint: The video ends on this picture. Works only with a first frame.
last.unsupported: This model cannot end on a picture.
last.dropped: This model does not take a last frame, so it will not be sent.

references.title: Reference pictures
references.hint: Up to {max} pictures of people, objects or style. The model keeps them in the video.
references.unsupported: This model does not take reference pictures.

warnings.frame_shadows_references: With a first frame this model does not take reference pictures, so they will not be sent.

storyboard.title: Storyboard
storyboard.shotPlaceholder: Describe the shot for the storyboard
storyboard.shotHelp: At first it is the video text. Changing it here does not change the video text.
storyboard.autoPanels: Let the model choose the number of panels
storyboard.fullText: The whole text for the picture model
storyboard.attachHelp: The storyboard goes to the video model as one of the reference pictures and shows the order of the shots.
storyboard.clearAsk: Remove the storyboard from this video? The picture stays in the media library.
storyboard.attached: The storyboard is sent with the video

take.reshootAsk: Make a new take? It replaces the video here. The old ones stay in the media library.

player.emptyHint: Describe what happens and press “Make video”.

making.take: Making the video ({n} s). It takes a few minutes.
making.extend: Making the next piece ({n} s). It takes a few minutes.
making.continue: Making a clip from the last frame ({n} s). It takes a few minutes.

player.frameHelp: A frame is saved to the media library as a picture, free of charge. It can go to the image studio or start a new video.
player.frameSaved: The frame is saved to the media library

extend.title: Extend the video
extend.noVideo: Make the video first, then it can be extended.
extend.otherModel: This video was made by another model. {model} will extend it, so the picture may change a little.
extend.downscale: The video is {from}, and the model extends only in {to}. The whole video will become {to}.
extend.tail: The model gets the last {n} s of the video (it is {length} s long) and continues from there.
extend.whatNext: What happens next. Leave it empty to use the video text.
extend.pauseOn: After each piece you look at it and press “Next piece”. You pay only for the pieces made.
extend.pauseOff: All pieces are made one after another without stopping.
extend.worstCase: The price is for all pieces. If you stop earlier, you pay only for what was made.
extend.restHelp: Press “Next piece” to go on, or drop the rest.
extend.undoAsk: Undo the last extension? The video goes back to the previous version. The removed piece stays in the media library.

plan.paused: Paused: look at the new piece

fromLast.title: Continue from the last frame
fromLast.help: A new clip starts from the last frame of this video and is joined to its end. Any model that starts from a picture can do it.

errors.video_busy: This video is being made. Wait or press “Stop”.
errors.video_field_unknown: The app sent something the video does not know. Reload the page.
errors.video_text_too_long: The text is too long: at most {max} characters.
errors.video_frame_not_image: This file is not a picture. Pick a picture.
errors.video_too_many_references: Too many pictures: {count}. The model takes at most {max}.
errors.video_brief_empty: Describe the video first: the text is what gets filmed.
errors.video_first_frame_unsupported: This model cannot start from a picture. Remove the first frame or pick another model.
errors.video_last_frame_needs_first: A last frame works only together with a first frame.
errors.video_last_frame_unsupported: This model cannot end on a picture. Remove the last frame or pick another model.
errors.video_camera_unknown: This camera move is not in the list. Pick another one.
errors.video_extend_unsupported: No model can extend the video now. Turn one on in the models screen.
errors.video_extend_length_unsupported: The model cannot make a piece of {seconds} s. It can make: {allowed} s.
errors.video_aspect_unsupported: This model does not make {aspect} videos. Pick another shape or model.
errors.video_nothing_to_undo: There is no extension to undo.
errors.video_interrupted: The app stopped while Google was making this clip. Start it again if you still want it (it will be paid again).
errors.video_input_too_large: The video is too big for the model: {size_mb} MB, at most {max_mb} MB.
errors.video_extend_format: The model does not take this video file. It takes: {mimes}.
errors.video_niche_empty: Say what the video is about first.
errors.video_brief_exists: The box already has a text.
errors.video_brief_busy: The text is being written. Wait a moment.
errors.video_brief_bad_answer: The model answered without a text. Try again.
errors.video_storyboard_empty: The model answered without a picture. Try again.
errors.video_storyboard_busy: The storyboard is being drawn. Wait a moment.
errors.video_frame_at: There is no frame at {at} s in this video.

tailSeconds.label: Seconds the model gets for an extension
tailSeconds.help: How many last seconds of the video go to the model when it is extended. More seconds keep the look better, but the file is bigger.

align.label: Join pieces on the matching frame
align.help: The app finds where the new piece repeats the end of the video and joins them there, so the motion does not jump.

crossfade.label: Smooth joint, seconds
crossfade.help: How long two pieces blend into each other at the joint. 0 means a straight cut.

researchDays.label: Keep a topic search, days
researchDays.help: A search for the same topic is used again for this many days, so you do not pay twice. 0 means search every time.
